$comment: Always-on token-cost estimates per MCP server, consumed by `cue cost`. Tool counts here are ESTIMATES observed from a live session's tool registry, not measured schema bytes — they end the old ~50x undercount but are not authoritative. Run `cue cost --probe-mcp` to write measured numbers to $CUE_CONFIG/mcp-token-estimates.json (which overrides this seed per id, source: probed). Servers with no entry fall back to a flagged `unknown` default. This file lives in the parent repo, NOT the resources/mcps submodule.
